mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declined month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a contraction in consumer demand that triggers a sell-off in equities, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing supply expansion regime (INDPRO > 115), rising industrial production signals strong economic activity that supports corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO > 115.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past month indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increased month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and monthly housing starts (HOUST) signal a broad-based economic slowdown that triggers equity market sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where both GDPC1 and HOUST decline quarter-over-quarter and month-over-month, respectively.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.0%), rising interest rates and persistent inflation compress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0 AND CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.0.
